newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound unchanged vs dlr in "dead" market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound unchanged vs dlr in "dead" market.

text.p: Egyptian bankers said the pound was unchanged against the dollar in a "dead" private-sector market on Tuesday, a holiday at the Central Bank and state-owned banks for the beginning of the new 1997/8 fiscal year.
Only one banker said he offered 3.3955 pounds for the dollar. He did not quote a bid rate.
On Monday, four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3930 pounds and 3.3960 pounds bid and at between 3.3940 pounds and 3.3980 pounds offered in the interbank market.
